gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tourney stretches bulky, oversized small letters wide with tracking, while Noto Sans Deseret, a sans-serif body, stays approachable. Athletic weight up top, open and legible text just below.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Tourney hits hard with wide-tracked, bulky letters and a uniform stroke, as plain as a stencil brush's line. Noto Sans Elymaic, a sans-serif with open apertures, keeps quiet beneath it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Loud, stretched out, and cut from a single-width line. Tourney keeps one monoline weight up top, while Noto Sans Ethiopic, a plain sans, brings a tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Tourney has no calligraphic modulation, just bulky, stretched-out letters. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, a sans with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, gives it a contemporary counterweight.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Bulky, stretched, athletic: Tourney keeps its stroke width unchanged from stem to curve. And Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a sans with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, keeps things modern below.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Clean and sturdy, Noto Sans Myanmar is a plain sans with a heavy-looking strip of text and a welcoming c opening. Next to Tourney's crossbars, fat as its stems, the mood stays hefty.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Smooth as drawn wire, Tourney stretches its bulky letters wide, with Noto Sans Oriya, a sans-serif, tucked in behind. Oriya's generous curves and tall small letters stay inviting.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tc: Athletic and loud, Tourney is rope-like in every stem. Noto Sans TC, a sans with large open counters and curves that open outward, gives that heft an approachable counterpart on the page.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Athletic, Tourney draws its curves with a rope's heft. Noto Sans Tifinagh, a sans-serif with inflated, open bowls that fill the line, makes longer reading feel clean and inviting.
gen-tourney-gf-onest: Wide, loud and built from a single stroke width, Tourney sits over Onest, a sans with short ascenders. Athletic punch up top, friendly big bowls and gentle line thickness below.
